RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Door Mat
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: can desync the dirtier colonists get. The "Doormats" mod is a multiplayer-safe alternative.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Character Editor
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: edits aren't shared between players, so any edit desyncs. Edit colonists before or after a live session.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Terraform Rimworld
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: rated as not working in live multiplayer.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: RimConnect
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: every purchase made on the RimConnect website desyncs a live session.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Search and Destroy
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: patched by the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility pack.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: RimThemes
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: looks only, no desyncs; Ideology prompts can't be cancelled while it's on.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Vanilla Hair Expanded
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: the barber's table is patched by the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility pack.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: RPG Style Inventory Revamped
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: patched by the bundled pack; dropping items from its inventory screen does nothing live, so drop them from the Gear tab.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: RimDark 40k - Framework
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: Rim Factions shares rank unlocks and accepted armor/weapon customization with everyone. Gene customization and colour presets still stay local.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: RimDark 40k - Mankinds Finest
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: several systems (colouring, Legion and Primarch materials) aren't shared between players.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Progression: Education
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: no desyncs, but scheduled classes never start during a live session.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Allow Tool
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: patched by the bundled pack. Turn its "Storage space alert" setting off to avoid log spam.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Designator Shapes
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: flood fill is patched by the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility pack.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Quarry
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: live sessions copy the host's mod settings to everyone, which keeps quarry resources the same.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Vanilla Traits Expanded
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: the absent-minded trait is patched by the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility pack.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Destroy Item
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: its order tool is kept in step by Multiplayer, and its settings are copied from the host.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Fortifications - Industrial
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: patched by the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility pack.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Alpha Memes
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: patched by the bundled pack, but some of its new funeral rituals can still desync when started.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Max Buy, Max Sell
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: works live.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: GrimWorld 40,000 - Framework
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: works live, except that turning a vox radio's aura off desyncs.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Blood Animations
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: the host should turn its "Filth Options" setting off; live sessions copy the host's settings to everyone.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Defensive Positions
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: no desyncs, but saved positions aren't shared with joining players.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: HugsLib
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: patched by the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility pack.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: ISEKAI RPG Leveling
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: stats, skill tree, forge and gizmos are synced by the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility pack.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Isekai Guild Faction add-on
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: patched by the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility pack.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Isekai Creatures add-on
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: patched by the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility pack.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Smarter Construction
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: while live its job changes are off (its unsaved caches desynced joiners); solo play keeps the whole mod.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Drafted Auto-Combat
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: Rim Factions syncs its buttons; its settings are the defaults while live.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Vanilla Trading Expanded
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: Rim Factions syncs the bank, stock market and contracts; terminal windows open only for the player who used it; its settings are the defaults while live.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Melee Animation
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: animations only while live: executions, grapples, lassos, duels and unique skills are off there (they're fine solo).

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Performance Optimizer
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility patch doesn't fit this version yet, so it may desync in live play; fine solo.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Vanilla Cooking Expanded framework
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility patch doesn't fit this version yet, so it may desync in live play; fine solo.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Vehicle Framework Auto Parking
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility patch doesn't fit this version yet, so it may desync in live play; fine solo.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Exosuit Framework
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: the bundled Multiplayer Compatibility patch doesn't fit this version yet, so it may desync in live play; fine solo.

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Exosuit Framework
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: Rim Factions syncs the ejector bay, suit turret and emergency eject buttons (the bundled pack's patch looks for old class names).

RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.label: Automatic Parking
RimFactions.Compat.LiveCompatDef.note: Rim Factions syncs saving, clearing and driving to parking spots (the bundled pack's patch doesn't fit this version).
